sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，人们在加利福尼亚州的一处葡萄园内发现了一具女性尸体。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她被斩首，体内的血液也被排干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机来隐瞒她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，人们只知道她叫无名氏。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 随后，侦探们终于知道了她的名字叫阿达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 但是，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《阿达》是“档案档案呈献”推出的全新系列节目，各大播客平台现已上线。

sentences.en: When 22-year-old Lisanne Froon told her parents she was planning a six-week trip to Costa Rica, they kept their concerns to themselves.
sentences.zh: 当22岁的利桑妮·弗龙告诉父母她计划去哥斯达黎加进行为期六周的旅行时，他们把心中的担忧压在了心底。

sentences.en: The Froon family lived in the Dutch city of Amersfoort and had never been outside of Europe.
sentences.zh: 弗龙一家住在荷兰城市阿默斯福特，从未离开过欧洲。

sentences.en: With relatively little travel experience, Lisanne's parents had reservations about their only daughter venturing to a foreign country, but they wanted to be supportive.
sentences.zh: 由于缺乏旅行经验，利桑妮的父母对独生女儿去外国冒险有所保留，但他们还是想给予支持。

sentences.en: Lisanne had been struggling with self-confidence, and a step outside her comfort zone could be exactly what she needed.
sentences.zh: 利桑妮一直在与自信心不足作斗争，走出舒适区可能正是她所需要的。

sentences.en: Besides, Lisanne was a sensible, intelligent, and introspective young woman who preferred nature and sports over partying.
sentences.zh: 此外，利桑妮是一个懂事、聪明、内省的年轻女性，比起聚会，她更喜欢大自然和运动。

sentences.en: She gave her family no reason to worry.
sentences.zh: 她没有给家人留下任何担忧的理由。

sentences.en: When the trip unexpectedly fell through, Lisanne's parents breathed the collective sigh of relief.
sentences.zh: 当这次旅行意外泡汤时，利桑妮的父母集体松了一口气。

sentences.en: But that relief was short-lived.
sentences.zh: 但这种解脱感并没有持续多久。

sentences.en: Before long, Lisanne announced the plan was back in action, but the destination had been changed.
sentences.zh: 没过多久，利桑妮宣布计划重启，但目的地变了。

sentences.en: She would be going to the neighbouring country of Panama instead.
sentences.zh: 她将改为前往邻国巴拿马。

sentences.en: In the lead-up to the trip, Lisanne sat her parents and older brother down and ran them through every step of her upcoming journey.
sentences.zh: 在出行前的准备阶段，利桑妮把父母和哥哥召集坐下，向他们详细讲解了即将到来的旅程的每一步。

sentences.en: She would be travelling with her close friend, 21-year-old Chris Kramers, a fine arts student with a flair for performing.
sentences.zh: 她将与亲密的朋友、21岁的克里斯·克拉梅尔同行，克里斯是一名极具表演天赋的美术专业学生。

sentences.en: The two had met four years prior while working at the same restaurant, and they'd recently moved into a shared house together.
sentences.zh: 两人四年前在同一家餐厅工作时相识，最近刚搬进一栋合租屋。

sentences.en: Chris had fallen in love with Latin America during a family vacation to Peru.
sentences.zh: 克里斯在一次秘鲁的家庭度假中爱上了拉丁美洲。

sentences.en: Since then, she'd fantasised about returning to the continent to study Spanish.
sentences.zh: 自那以后，她就幻想着重返这片大陆学习西班牙语。

sentences.en: Chris was extroverted, creative, and outgoing, complimenting Lisanne's quieter and more reserved personality.
sentences.zh: 克里斯性格外向、富有创造力、爽朗大方，这与利桑妮安静内敛的性格相得益彰。

sentences.en: The two friends had a shared vision.
sentences.zh: 这两个朋友有着共同的愿景。

sentences.en: They didn't just want a simple vacation through typical tourist traps.
sentences.zh: 她们不想要仅仅穿梭于典型旅游陷阱的简单假期。

sentences.en: They wanted a special trip, one that held significance.
sentences.zh: 她们想要一次特别的、具有非凡意义的旅行。

sentences.en: They'd spend two weeks in the coastal Panamanian town of Bocas del Toro, exploring the beaches while taking Spanish classes.
sentences.zh: 她们将在巴拿马沿海小镇博卡斯德尔托罗度过两周，在学习西班牙语的同时探索海滩。

sentences.en: Then, it was on to the mountain region of Bocchete, where they'd immerse themselves in the local culture and language and do some volunteer work at a daycare centre.
sentences.zh: 然后，前往博克特山脉地区，在那里沉浸于当地的文化和语言，并在托儿所做一些志愿工作。

sentences.en: Lisanne's brother deemed it unnecessary for his sister to go through their plans in such detail, but that's just the kind of person she was, organised to a T.
sentences.zh: 利桑妮的哥哥觉得妹妹没必要把计划做得这么详细，但她就是那种做事一丝不苟的人。

sentences.en: As the big day approached, Lisanne was apprehensive, yet excited.
sentences.zh: 随着大日子临近，利桑妮既忐忑又兴奋。

sentences.en: Having spent the past few years working part-time while studying for her degree in applied psychology, she was ready for an adventure.
sentences.zh: 在过去几年里，她一边攻读应用心理学学位，一边打兼职，她已经准备好迎接一场冒险了。

sentences.en: The departing flight was scheduled for March 15, 2014.
sentences.zh: 离港航班定于2014年3月15日。

sentences.en: When the day came, Lisanne checked in at Amsterdam's Skiphole Airport and stood waiting with her parents.
sentences.zh: 到了那天，利桑妮在阿姆斯特丹史基浦机场办理了登机手续，并和父母站在一起等待。

sentences.en: Chris Kramers was running late.
sentences.zh: 克里斯·克拉梅尔迟到了。

sentences.en: With each passing minute, the ever-punctual Lisanne grew more anxious.
sentences.zh: 每过一分钟，一向守时的利桑妮就愈发焦虑。

sentences.en: Lisanne's parents reassured her that Chris would arrive any moment.
sentences.zh: 利桑妮的父母安慰她，说克里斯随时都会到。

sentences.en: While they too had been nervous about the trip, they now gazed at their daughter with nothing but pride and admiration.
sentences.zh: 虽然他们对这次旅行也曾感到紧张，但现在他们满心自豪和钦佩地看着女儿。

sentences.en: When Chris finally arrived, Lisanne's anxiety gave way to excitement.
sentences.zh: 当克里斯终于到达时，利桑妮的焦虑化为了兴奋。

sentences.en: Peter Froon embraced his daughter into a tight bear hug.
sentences.zh: 彼得·弗龙将女儿紧紧地抱在怀里。

sentences.en: Make the most of it, her mother said.
sentences.zh: “尽情享受吧，”她母亲说。

sentences.en: In high spirits, the two friends took off down the long hallway leading to their flight.
sentences.zh: 带着高昂的兴致，两个朋友顺着通往航班的长廊出发了。

sentences.en: Just before they disappeared from view, Lisanne turned around and waved a final goodbye.
sentences.zh: 就在她们消失在视野中之前，利桑妮转过身挥手作最后的告别。

sentences.en: At that moment, Peter relaxed.
sentences.zh: 那一刻，彼得放松了。

sentences.en: It was clear to him that his daughter no longer had any hesitations.
sentences.zh: 很明显，女儿已经没有任何犹豫了。

sentences.en: She was ready.
sentences.zh: 她准备好了。

sentences.en: The four parents decided to grab a quick coffee together.
sentences.zh: 四位家长决定一起去喝杯咖啡。

sentences.en: This was the first time they'd ever met, and with their daughters embarking on such a major adventure together, it was suggested that they exchange phone numbers.
sentences.zh: 这是他们第一次见面，鉴于女儿们要一起展开如此重大的冒险，有人建议他们交换电话号码。

sentences.en: Surely they'd never need to use them.
sentences.zh: 当然，她们永远不会需要用到这些号码。

sentences.en: But just in case.
sentences.zh: 但以防万一嘛。

sentences.en: For Chris Kramers and Lisanne Froon, the trip started out like a dream.
sentences.zh: 对克里斯·克拉梅尔和利桑妮·弗龙来说，这趟旅程一开始就像一场梦。

sentences.en: After overcoming the shock of jet lag, they spent the first leg of their journey embracing the tropical heat and Caribbean lifestyle of Bocas del Toro.
sentences.zh: 在克服了时差带来的冲击后，她们旅程的第一阶段沉浸在博卡斯德尔托罗的热带酷暑和加勒比生活方式中。

sentences.en: They took Spanish classes, went island hopping, and hung out with fellow travellers.
sentences.zh: 她们上了西班牙语课，在各个岛屿间跳岛游，并与同行旅客打成一片。

sentences.en: They snorkeled, danced in a tropical rainstorm, and ate incredible food.
sentences.zh: 她们浮潜，在热带暴雨中跳舞，吃了难以置信的美食。

sentences.en: It was unlike anything they'd ever experienced.
sentences.zh: 这是她们从未体验过的。

sentences.en: After a day trip to the nearby Zapatilla Island,
sentences.zh: 在对附近的扎帕蒂利亚岛进行了一日游之后，

sentences.en: Lisanne wrote in her diary,
sentences.zh: 利桑妮在日记中写道：

sentences.en: I could not believe my eyes.
sentences.zh: “我简直不敢相信自己的眼睛。

sentences.en: It was one big paradise.
sentences.zh: 这是一个巨大的天堂。

sentences.en: Exactly like in your dreaMs.
sentences.zh: 完全就像梦中一样。”

sentences.en: Even a temporary stomach bug couldn't keep Chris's spirits down.
sentences.zh: 即使是暂时的肠胃不适也没有削弱克里斯的好心情。

sentences.en: As their time in Bocas del Toro drew to an end, she struggled to say goodbye.
sentences.zh: 随着她们在博卡斯德尔托罗的时光接近尾声，她很难开口说再见。

sentences.en: The time we had in Bocas was really amazing,
sentences.zh: “我们在博卡斯度过的时光真的很棒，”

sentences.en: Chris wrote in her diary.
sentences.zh: 克里斯在日记中写道。

sentences.en: We really had a holiday there.
sentences.zh: “我们在那里真正度过了一个假期。

sentences.en: I have never seen a place with such a beautiful coastline and palm trees and such.
sentences.zh: 我从未见过拥有如此美丽海岸线、棕榈树之类的地方。

sentences.en: Really super.
sentences.zh: 真的超级棒。”

sentences.en: Chris and Lisanne arrived in Bocete on Saturday, March 29, 2014.
sentences.zh: 克里斯和利桑妮于2014年3月29日星期六抵达博克特。

sentences.en: Located in the western province of Chiriquí, just 60 kilometres from the Costa Rican border,
sentences.zh: 博克特位于奇里基省西部，距离哥斯达黎加边境仅60公里，

sentences.en: Bocete is a quaint mountain town known for its hiking trails, waterfalls, coffee plantations, and lush scenery.
sentences.zh: 是一个古雅的山地小镇，以远足小径、瀑布、咖啡种植园和郁郁葱葱的风景而闻名。

sentences.en: At 1,200 metres above sea level, the cooler climate makes it a popular destination for tourists seeking nature and outdoor adventure.
sentences.zh: 这里海拔1200米，凉爽的气候使其成为寻求自然和户外冒险的游客的热门目的地。

sentences.en: With the significant expat community, Bocete promised Lisanne and Chris a unique experience without being too far off the beaten path.
sentences.zh: 凭借着庞大的外籍侨民社区，博克特为利桑妮和克里斯提供了一种独特的体验，同时又不会太偏僻。

sentences.en: The young women had arranged to stay with a local family who rented out rooms to international guests.
sentences.zh: 这两个年轻女子原本安排和当地一个向国际游客出租房间的家庭同住。

sentences.en: Not only did this suit their budget, it allowed them a genuine insight into local life.
sentences.zh: 这不仅符合她们的预算，还让她们对当地生活有了真实的了解。

sentences.en: But this culture shock quickly proved overwhelming for Lisanne.
sentences.zh: 但这种文化冲击很快被证明让利桑妮感到难以招架。

sentences.en: On the night of their arrival, she confided in her diary that she wanted to go home.
sentences.zh: 在抵达当晚，她在日记中吐露自己想回家。

sentences.en: Although the place was beautiful and the host family was friendly,
sentences.zh: 虽然这个地方很美，寄宿家庭也很友好，

sentences.en: Lisanne felt that the switch from vacation mode to living the real life of a real Panamanian was too much.
sentences.zh: 但利桑妮觉得从度假模式切换到真正的巴拿马人真实生活太沉重了。

sentences.en: She wrote,
sentences.zh: 她写道：

sentences.en: I thought I should be able to do this, the final test, before I can be really happy with myself.
sentences.zh: “我以为我能做到这一点，这是最终的考验，在此之后我才能真正对自己感到满意。

sentences.en: So far, I have failed badly.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，我彻底失败了。”

sentences.en: Chris wrote about struggling to adapt to the new environment as well, but after a decent night's sleep, both women were in better spirits.
sentences.zh: 克里斯也写到了自己难以适应新环境，但在美美地睡了一觉后，两人的心情都有所好转。

sentences.en: They spent the next day exploring the town and checking out some tours advertised in the local Spanish school.
sentences.zh: 第二天，她们花时间探索了小镇，并查看了当地西班牙语学校宣传的一些旅行团。

sentences.en: Months prior to leaving the Netherlands, they'd arranged to volunteer at a Bocete children's centre called Aura Daycare.
sentences.zh: 离开荷兰几个月前，她们就安排好要去博克特一个名为“奥拉日托儿所”的儿童中心当志愿者。

sentences.en: Both friends were looking forward to it immensely.
sentences.zh: 两个朋友都无比期待。

sentences.en: But when they arrived at Aura on Monday, March 31, they didn't get the warm welcome they anticipated.
sentences.zh: 但当她们在3月31日星期一到达奥拉时，并没有受到预期中的热烈欢迎。

sentences.en: The staff weren't expecting the pair for another week and had no use for them in the meantime.
sentences.zh: 工作人员并没有料到她们会提前一周来，暂时用不上她们。

sentences.en: Put off by the cold treatment they received,
sentences.zh: 受到冷遇的打击，

sentences.en: Chris wrote in her diary,
sentences.zh: 克里斯在日记中写道：

sentences.en: Lisanne's diary entry was more succinct.
sentences.zh: 利桑妮的日记则更为简短。

sentences.en: Yuck, yuck, yuck, she wrote.
sentences.zh: “真恶心，真恶心，真恶心，”她写道。

sentences.en: Our first day was a disaster.
sentences.zh: “我们的第一天简直是一场灾难。”

sentences.en: In an attempt to shake off their disappointment, the young women went to the Spanish school to discuss alternative volunteer projects.
sentences.zh: 为了摆脱失望情绪，两名年轻女子前往西班牙语学校讨论其他的志愿者项目。

sentences.en: They found another they liked the sound of and hoped they could begin in the next couple of days.
sentences.zh: 她们找到了另一个听起来不错的项目，并希望能在接下来的几天里开始。

sentences.en: While they waited for a response from the volunteer coordinator, they treated themselves to a massage.
sentences.zh: 在等待志愿者协调员回复的同时，她们犒劳自己做了一次按摩。

sentences.en: Chris wrote,
sentences.zh: 克里斯写道：

sentences.en: On the morning of Wednesday, April 2, 2014,
sentences.zh: 2014年4月2日星期三上午，

sentences.en: Bocete tour guide Feliciana González stood at the Spanish school waiting for Lisanne Froon and Chris Kramers.
sentences.zh: 博克特导游菲利西亚纳·冈萨雷斯站在西班牙语学校等待利桑妮·弗龙和克里斯·克拉梅尔。

sentences.en: The previous morning, the Dutch tourists had booked a tour with Feliciano to visit a nearby farm.
sentences.zh: 就在昨天早上，这两位荷兰游客跟菲利西亚诺预订了一个参观附近农场的旅行团。

sentences.en: A German woman named Eileen who worked at the Spanish school also decided to join them.
sentences.zh: 一位在西班牙语学校工作的名叫艾琳的德国女性也决定加入她们。

sentences.en: But as the minutes ticked by, there was no sign of Lisanne and Chris.
sentences.zh: 但随着分秒过去，不见利桑妮和克里斯的踪影。

sentences.en: Feliciano knew the young women were staying with a host family who lived just a few minutes from the Spanish school.
sentences.zh: 菲利西亚诺知道这两个年轻女子住在距离西班牙语学校仅几分钟路程的寄宿家庭里。

sentences.en: He and Eileen walked to the house to see if Chris and Lisanne were there and had perhaps got their times mixed up.
sentences.zh: 他和艾琳走到那栋房子，看看克里斯和利桑妮是否在那里，或许是记错时间了。

sentences.en: No one appeared to be home and the curtains to the guest room were pulled shut.
sentences.zh: 家里似乎没有人，客房的窗帘也拉上了。

sentences.en: Feliciano phoned the homeowner, a woman named Miriam, to ask if she knew where the Dutch women could be.
sentences.zh: 菲利西亚诺打电话给房东、一个名叫米里亚姆的女人，询问她是否知道这两个荷兰女人在哪里。

sentences.en: Miriam had no idea.
sentences.zh: 米里亚姆一无所知。

sentences.en: She said that Chris and Lisanne were still out when she went to bed the previous evening.
sentences.zh: 她说，前一天晚上她去睡觉时，克里斯和利桑妮还没回来。

sentences.en: She hadn't seen them that morning either, but had left them breakfast before heading off to work.
sentences.zh: 她那天早上也没看到她们，但在出门上班前给她们留下了早餐。

sentences.en: Miriam told Feliciano where he could find a spare key and gave him permission to go inside.
sentences.zh: 米里亚姆告诉菲利西亚诺在哪里可以找到备用钥匙，并允许他进去。

sentences.en: He entered Chris and Lisanne's room.
sentences.zh: 他进入了克里斯和利桑妮的房间。

sentences.en: The room was relatively tidy and the two single beds didn't appear to have been slept in.
sentences.zh: 房间相对整洁，两张单人床看起来并没有人睡过。

sentences.en: Some of the women's personal belongings, including mobile phone charges, were spread out across their beds and the bedside table,
sentences.zh: 女人们的一些私人物品，包括手机充电器，散落在床铺和床头柜上，

sentences.en: while the rest of their luggage was packed away into the cupboards.
sentences.zh: 而其余的行李则收在橱柜里。

sentences.en: Wherever Lisanne and Chris were, the state of their room indicated that they didn't intend to be gone for long.
sentences.zh: 无论利桑妮和克里斯在哪里，她们房间的状态表明她们并不打算离开太久。

sentences.en: Feliciano and Eileen reasoned that the pair had likely changed their plans last minute without informing anyone.
sentences.zh: 菲利西亚诺和艾琳推断，两人很可能是临时改变了计划却没有通知任何人。

sentences.en: They decided to check in later that day to make sure all was well.
sentences.zh: 他们决定当天晚些时候再来看看，确保一切安好。

sentences.en: By the time Miriam returned home from work, the breakfast she'd put out for her guests remained untouched.
sentences.zh: 当米里亚姆下班回家时，她为客人们准备的早餐原封不动。

sentences.en: By sundown, Lisanne and Chris still hadn't returned to Miriam's, nor had they contacted anyone to inform them of their whereabouts.
sentences.zh: 直到日落，利桑妮和克里斯仍未回到米里亚姆家，也没有联系任何人告知行踪。

sentences.en: Feliciano and Eileen went to the police to report the pair missing.
sentences.zh: 菲利西亚诺和艾琳去警察局报案称两人失踪。

sentences.en: It was the middle of the night in the Netherlands when Lisanne's mother, Dini Froon, was awoken by the ringing of the phone.
sentences.zh: 荷兰正值深夜，利桑妮的母亲迪妮·弗龙被急促的电话铃声惊醒。

sentences.en: Fear washed over her as she was informed that her daughter had failed to return to her lodgings for the night.
sentences.zh: 当得知女儿昨晚没有回住处时，恐惧向她袭来。

sentences.en: Dini and her husband Peter called the emergency number for the travel agency that had organised Chris and Lisanne's trip.
sentences.zh: 迪妮和丈夫彼得拨打了为克里斯和利桑妮安排行程的旅行社的紧急电话。

sentences.en: The woman there assured the worried parents that the girls had likely gone out for the night and would return soon.
sentences.zh: 那里的女性向焦急的父母保证，女孩们可能只是出去过夜了，很快就会回来。

sentences.en: It was only when she started making some calls around Bocchette on the Froon's behalf that they realised the pair hadn't slept at Miriam's the previous night either.
sentences.zh: 直到她开始代表弗龙一家在博克特四处打电话，他们才意识到两人前一晚也没有在米里亚姆家睡觉。

sentences.en: It dawned on them.
sentences.zh: 他们猛然意识到。

sentences.en: Chris and Lisanne had already been missing for over 24 hours.
sentences.zh: 克里斯和利桑妮已经失踪超过24小时了。

sentences.en: Dinny immediately went on the hunt for the Kramer's phone number.
sentences.zh: 迪妮立刻开始寻找克拉梅尔家的电话号码。

sentences.en: It turned out they'd be needing it after all.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，他们终究还是需要用到它。

sentences.en: By the morning of Thursday April 3, word quickly spread throughout Bocchette that two young Dutch women were missing.
sentences.zh: 到4月3日星期四上午，博克特迅速传开了两名年轻荷兰女性失踪的消息。

sentences.en: Locals were eager to join the search, but nobody knew where to look.
sentences.zh: 当地人急于加入搜寻，但没有人知道该去哪里找。

sentences.en: Chris and Lisanne hadn't told anyone what their plans were for the previous couple of days,
sentences.zh: 克里斯和利桑妮没有告诉任何人她们前几天有什么计划，

sentences.en: nor had they left a note in their room, sent any texts, or written anything in their diaries about where they intended on going.
sentences.zh: 也没有在房间里留便条、发任何短信，或在日记中写下她们打算去哪里。

sentences.en: Although the two had taken smartphones with them, neither device was equipped with a Panamanian SIM card.
sentences.zh: 尽管两人随身携带了智能手机，但两台设备都没有配备巴拿马SIM卡。

sentences.en: Chris and Lisanne had simply been using their phones to connect to the internet using Wi-Fi, which was how they maintained contact with loved ones back home.
sentences.zh: 克里斯和利桑妮只是使用手机通过Wi-Fi连接互联网，这也是她们与远在家乡的亲人保持联系的方式。

sentences.en: Mobile records gave no indication of where they could be,
sentences.zh: 移动记录没有显示她们可能在哪里的迹象，

sentences.en: but a check of the internet history at the Spanish school confirmed that the pair had searched for information about a popular hiking trail known as the Pionista.
sentences.zh: 但对西班牙语学校互联网历史记录的检查证实，两人曾搜索过有关一条名为“皮奥尼斯塔”的热门远足小径的信息。

sentences.en: A ten-minute drive outside of town, the Pionista offers visitors the opportunity to walk to the top of the Continental Divide.
sentences.zh: 距离镇中心有十分钟车程，“皮奥尼斯塔”为游客提供了步行到达大陆分水岭顶部的机会。

sentences.en: The trail begins across open fields before weaving upwards through dense forests until it reaches the summit known as the Mirador at roughly 6,500 feet above sea level.
sentences.zh: 小径从开阔的田野开始，随后向上穿过茂密的森林，直到到达海拔约6500英尺、被称为米拉多尔的山顶。

sentences.en: On a clear day, the Mirador offers a 360-degree view of the forest canopy stretching all the way to the ocean.
sentences.zh: 在晴朗的日子里，米拉多尔可以360度俯瞰一直延伸到海洋的森林树冠。

sentences.en: For the healthy, able-bodied individual, the Pionista can be completed within about five to six hours.
sentences.zh: 对于身体健康、体魄健全的人来说，“皮奥尼斯塔”大约五到六个小时就能走完。

sentences.en: It's a relatively straightforward, albeit challenging hike, with a single, defined track taking individuals all the way to the summit and back down again.
sentences.zh: 这是一条相对直接但具有挑战性的远足路线，有一条单一、明确的小径一直通往山顶再返回。

sentences.en: Many people choose to take an experienced tour guide with them, but it's not unusual for travellers to do it without one.
sentences.zh: 很多人选择带上有经验的导游，但游客独自前往也并不罕见。

sentences.en: Feliciano Gonzalez, the tour guide who'd realised Chris and Lisanne were missing, said that he'd offered to take the pair to the Pionista, but they'd declined.
sentences.zh: 意识到克里斯和利桑妮失踪的导游菲利西亚诺·冈萨雷斯说，他曾主动提出带两人去皮奥尼斯塔，但被她们拒绝了。

sentences.en: Their online search history suggested that they might have decided to hike it alone.
sentences.zh: 她们的网上搜索历史表明，她们可能决定独自去远足。

sentences.en: Various witnesses reported having seen a pair matching Chris and Lisanne's description heading towards the Pionista on Tuesday April 1.
sentences.zh: 多位目击者报告称，在4月1日星期二看到一对符合克里斯和利桑妮外貌特征的人正朝皮奥尼斯塔方向走去。

sentences.en: The problem was, no one could say with utmost certainty that the women they'd seen had definitely been the missing Dutch duo.
sentences.zh: 问题是，没有人能百分之百肯定他们看到的女人绝对就是失踪的荷兰二人组。

sentences.en: Chris and Lisanne were both white and slender, with strawberry blonde and light brown hair.
sentences.zh: 克里斯和利桑妮都是白人且身材苗条，有着草莓金和浅棕色的头发。

sentences.en: They looked similar to many of the other young European backpackers who frequented the area.
sentences.zh: 她们看起来与经常光顾该地区的许多其他年轻欧洲背包客相似。

sentences.en: Complicating things further, no one knew for sure what the pair had been wearing or carrying when they left their guesthouse on Tuesday morning,
sentences.zh: 更复杂的是，没有人确切知道两人在周二上午离开宾馆时穿了什么、带了什么，

sentences.en: and witness descriptions of their clothing varied.
sentences.zh: 目击者对她们衣着的描述各不相同。

sentences.en: One witness claimed to have seen Chris and Lisanne waiting for a taxi in town at around 1.45pm.
sentences.zh: 一名目击者声称看到克里斯和利桑妮于下午1点45分左右在镇上等出租车。

sentences.en: This was supported by a taxi driver, who recalled picking the pair up and dropping them off at a hostel called Casa Pedro shortly before 2pm.
sentences.zh: 这得到了名出租车司机的证实，他回忆说，下午2点前不久，他曾接上这两人，并把她们送到一家名为卡萨佩德罗的旅舍。

sentences.en: The hostel was about a 20-minute walk from the Pionista trailhead.
sentences.zh: 这家旅舍距离皮奥尼斯塔徒步路线起点大约有20分钟的步行路程。

sentences.en: According to the owner of the hostel, the duo asked about hiking the Pionista, but later changed their mind, saying they were going to head back into town instead.
sentences.zh: 据旅舍老板娘透露，两人曾打听过徒步皮奥尼斯塔路线的事，但后来改变了主意，说她们打算回镇上去。

sentences.en: On the main road in front of the hiking trail was a restaurant called Il Pionista.
sentences.zh: 徒步路线正前方的主路上有一家名为伊尔皮奥尼斯塔的餐厅。

sentences.en: A restaurant employee claimed to have seen the pair heading up the trail sometime between 3 and 3.30pm.
sentences.zh: 一名餐厅员工声称，在下午3点到3点30分之间的某个时间，看到两人朝小路上走去。

sentences.en: A dog belonging to the restaurant's owners often accompanied tourists on their hikes.
sentences.zh: 餐厅老板养的一只狗经常陪同游客徒步。

sentences.en: According to the employee, the dog followed the women but returned later on alone.
sentences.zh: 据这名员工称，那只狗跟着两个女人，但后来独自回来了。

sentences.en: A local woman claimed she saw Chris and Lisanne heading up the mountain at around 4.15pm.
sentences.zh: 当地一名女子声称，她看到克里斯和莉桑在下午4点15分左右朝山上走去。

sentences.en: Concerned that they weren't adequately dressed and that it was getting too late to complete the track before dark,
sentences.zh: 由于担心她们穿着不够暖和，而且天色渐晚，可能无法在天黑前走完全程，

sentences.en: the woman warned the girls in Spanish not to go up the mountain alone.
sentences.zh: 这名女子用西班牙语警告两个女孩不要独自上山。

sentences.en: They didn't appear to have understood.
sentences.zh: 她们似乎没有听懂。

sentences.en: Volunteer search teams began scouring the Pionista but found no sign of the missing women.
sentences.zh: 志愿搜寻队开始在皮奥尼斯塔进行搜查，但没有发现失踪女性的任何迹象。

sentences.en: If Chris and Lisanne were indeed out there, they considered this a little unusual.
sentences.zh: 如果克里斯和莉桑真的在那里，他们会觉得这有点反常。

sentences.en: Although the narrow trail was surrounded on both sides by dense forest, it was designed with tourists in mind and therefore difficult to veer off track.
sentences.zh: 尽管狭窄的小路两侧环绕着茂密的森林，但它是专为游客设计的，因此很难偏离路线。

sentences.en: The vegetation surrounding the trail was thick to a point of being almost impenetrable.
sentences.zh: 小路周围的植被十分茂密，几乎到了密不透风的地步。

sentences.en: If one veered off course, they wouldn't be able to go very far, especially if they weren't appropriately dressed.
sentences.zh: 如果有人偏离了路线，他们将无法走太远，特别是如果他们的穿着不合适的话。

sentences.en: Once hikers reached the summit, they typically turned around and headed back down the mountain the same way they came up.
sentences.zh: 一旦徒步者到达山顶，他们通常会原路返回，顺着上山时的路下山。

sentences.en: Had Chris or Lisanne gotten injured or sick during their hike, common sense dictated that they would have likely just stayed where they were until someone came by.
sentences.zh: 如果克里斯或莉桑在徒步过程中受伤或生病，常识告诉人们，她们很可能会留在原地，直到有人经过。

sentences.en: The trail was managed and monitored by park rangers.
sentences.zh: 这条小路由公园管理员管理和监控。

sentences.en: Hikers passed through the trail every day, not just tourists but locals and members of the indigenous tribes that lived on the other side of the Continental Divide.
sentences.zh: 每天都有人从这条小路上经过，不仅有游客，还有当地人和生活在大分水岭另一侧的土著部落成员。

sentences.en: However, the trail didn't technically end at the Mirador.
sentences.zh: 然而，严格来说，这条小路并没有在米拉多尔结束。

sentences.en: On the other side of the summit, a rugged passage led off the tourist track and onto a precarious web of trails used almost exclusively by members of the indigenous Norbear tribe.
sentences.zh: 在山顶的另一侧，一条崎岖的小路通向游客路线之外，连接着几乎只供诺尔贝尔部落成员使用的险峻小路网。

sentences.en: This is where things became dicey.
sentences.zh: 事情就是从这里开始变得棘手的。

sentences.en: If Lisanne and Chris had mistakenly decided to walk onwards, they could have gotten lost, especially if they'd miscalculated how much time they had before sundown.
sentences.zh: 如果莉桑和克里斯错误地决定继续往前走，她们可能会迷路，特别是如果她们算错离日落还有多少时间的话。

sentences.en: The trail was manageable for a while, but it eventually led into a paddock where the path became difficult to re-establish.
sentences.zh: 这条小路在一段距离内还算好走，但最终通向一片很难重新辨认路径的牧场。

sentences.en: Tour guide Feliciano Gonzalez was an expert on the pianista.
sentences.zh: 导游费利西亚诺冈萨雷斯是皮亚尼斯塔方面的专家。

sentences.en: Not only did he take many tourists there, his family also owned property on the other side of the Divide.
sentences.zh: 他不仅带许多游客去那里，他的家人在大分水岭的另一侧也拥有房产。

sentences.en: Feliciano told the Dutch Broadcasting Foundation that it wasn't possible to lose track of the trail and wander into the forest without noticing.
sentences.zh: 费利西亚诺告诉荷兰广播基金会，不可能在不知不觉中迷失路线并误入森林。

sentences.en: He said,
sentences.zh: 他说，

sentences.en: Had this been the case, the missing women were in danger of succumbing to dehydration, hunger, or the elements.
sentences.zh: 如果是这样的话，失踪的女性将面临因脱水、饥饿或恶劣天气而丧命的危险。

sentences.en: April 1 had been a warm, clear day, but once the sun set, the temperature dropped significantly.
sentences.zh: 4月1日原本是个温暖晴朗的日子，但太阳落山后，气温显著下降。

sentences.en: Without appropriate gear or clothing, hypothermia posed a genuine risk.
sentences.zh: 如果没有合适的装备或衣物，低体温症将带来真正的风险。

sentences.en: Lisanne had asthma and had been struggling with a bad cough.
sentences.zh: 莉桑患有哮喘，而且一直在饱受严重咳嗽的困扰。

sentences.en: This could have been exacerbated by changes in the altitude or exposure to the elements, which would only get worse in the coming days as the rainy season kicked in.
sentences.zh: 海拔的变化或恶劣天气的侵袭可能会加剧这种情况，随着雨季的到来，接下来的几天里情况只会变得更糟。

sentences.en: Search teams traversed the other side of the summit but found no sign of the missing women there either.
sentences.zh: 搜寻队搜查了山顶的另一侧，但也没有在那里发现失踪女性的任何踪迹。

sentences.en: This added weight to the possibility that the two friends could have completed the hike without incident and disappeared thereafter.
sentences.zh: 这进一步增加了这样一种可能性：这两个朋友可能顺利完成了徒步，然后就此失踪了。

sentences.en: One local business owner claimed he saw two women matching the description of Chris and Lisanne coming down the mountain in the late afternoon of April 1, looking tired and grumpy.
sentences.zh: 当地一名企业主声称，他在4月1日傍晚看到两个外貌特征与克里斯和莉桑相符的女性正疲惫且暴躁地从山上下来。

sentences.en: They asked for the best way to get back to Boquete.
sentences.zh: 她们打听返回博克特的最佳路线。

sentences.en: He advised them to take a taxi, but he didn't see which direction they went or what they did from there.
sentences.zh: 他建议她们坐出租车，但他没有看到她们往哪个方向走，也没有看到她们从那里做了什么。

sentences.en: Back in the Netherlands, the Kramers and Froon families did all they could from their end.
sentences.zh: 远在荷兰的克勒默和弗龙两家尽其所能做着他们能做的一切。

sentences.en: They reported the disappearance to police in Amersfoort, notified Interpol, and created a Facebook page appealing for information.
sentences.zh: 他们向阿默斯福特的警方报案，通知了国际刑警组织，并创建了一个呼吁提供线索的脸书页面。

sentences.en: As the search gained momentum, the families reassured themselves that the duo would likely turn up soon with a valid explanation.
sentences.zh: 随着搜寻工作的推进，家属们安慰自己说，这两人可能很快就会带着一个合理的解释出现。

sentences.en: But as the search reached its fourth fruitless day, concerns heightened.
sentences.zh: 但随着搜寻工作进入第四天却毫无收获，担忧加剧了。

sentences.en: Panama's National Civil Protection Unit, CINAPROC, took over the mission and called for all the volunteer search parties to stand down.
sentences.zh: 巴拿马国家民防部队西纳普罗接管了搜寻任务，并要求所有志愿搜寻队撤回。

sentences.en: Working on the belief that the pair were lost in the wilderness, a map was created of all the possible locations that Chris and Lisanne might have visited.
sentences.zh: 基于两人在荒野中迷路的判断，绘制了一张地图，标注了克里斯和莉桑可能去过的所有潜在地点。

sentences.en: 25 routes throughout the Baru National Park that surrounded the pianista were identified, with a team of 40 CINAPROC rescuers and 35 agents from the National Police
sentences.zh: 确定了巴鲁国家公园内环绕皮亚尼斯塔的25条路线，并指派了40名西纳普罗救援人员和35名国家警察特工

sentences.en: tasked with conducting the search.
sentences.zh: 负责开展搜寻工作。

sentences.en: Sniffer dogs were also brought in, but after a week of dry, clear weather, rainy conditions added an extra challenge to the already difficult exploration.
sentences.zh: 搜救犬也被调了过来，但在经历了干旱晴朗的天气之后，雨天给本已艰难的探索增添了额外的挑战。

sentences.en: It also increased the fears for Chris and Lisanne's wellbeing.
sentences.zh: 这也增加了人们对克里斯和莉桑安危的担忧。

sentences.en: While the trails could have been manageable at first, the intense rain turned them into muddy, unforgiving passageways, the babbling streams transforming into rushing rivers.
sentences.zh: 虽然这些小路一开始可能还算好走，但暴雨将它们变成了泥泞、难行的通道，潺潺的溪流也变成了奔腾的河流。

sentences.en: Some small vacant huts along the trails could have provided adequate shelter, but these were checked and no signs were found to indicate Chris and Lisanne had stayed within.
sentences.zh: 小路沿途的一些小型空置小屋本可以提供充足的庇护所，但经过检查，没有发现任何迹象表明克里斯和莉桑曾在其中逗留。

sentences.en: If they'd sought shelter in a cave or crevice somewhere, this would only make them more difficult to find,
sentences.zh: 如果她们在某个洞穴或岩缝中寻求庇护，这只会让找到她们变得更加困难，

sentences.en: with any screams for help most likely being absorbed by the surrounding jungle.
sentences.zh: 任何求救的呐喊都很可能会被周围的丛林所吞没。

sentences.en: Members of Chris and Lisanne's families flew to Panama to join the search efforts.
sentences.zh: 克里斯和莉桑家属的成员飞往巴拿马加入搜寻工作。

sentences.en: In a bid to encourage indigenous people from the other side of the continental divide to continue the search, they announced a $2,500 reward.
sentences.zh: 为了鼓励大分水岭另一侧的土著居民继续搜寻，他们悬赏2500美元。

sentences.en: Still, the days ticked by with no leads.
sentences.zh: 然而，日子一天天过去，依然没有任何线索。

sentences.en: Some started to criticise Cineproc's approach, calling for the search to be expanded beyond the national park and to other areas the missing women might have headed to.
sentences.zh: 一些人开始批评西纳普罗的方法，呼吁将搜寻范围扩大到国家公园之外，延伸至失踪女性可能前往的其他区域。

sentences.en: If the Dutch women had made it back from the pianista, officials could be wasting precious time by not properly exploring other options.
sentences.zh: 如果这两名荷兰女性已经从皮亚尼斯塔返回，官员们如果不妥善探索其他选择，可能会浪费宝贵的时间。

sentences.en: By April 14, two weeks had passed with no breakthroughs.
sentences.zh: 到了4月14日，两周时间过去了，依然没有任何突破。

sentences.en: If Chris and Lisanne were out in the wilderness, their chances of survival at this point were slim.
sentences.zh: 如果克里斯和莉桑当时身处荒野，她们此时生还的几率微乎其微。

sentences.en: The intensive search was scaled back, with the investigation handed over to the public ministry.
sentences.zh: 高强度的搜寻规模缩减了，调查工作移交给了公共部。

sentences.en: Panamanian and Dutch authorities worked collaboratively to generate leads and provide support to the families.
sentences.zh: 巴拿马和荷兰当局协同合作，寻找线索并为家属提供支持。

sentences.en: But, as each day passed with no new information emerging, the belief that Chris and Lisanne were lost gave way to a new prevailing theory.
sentences.zh: 但是，随着每一天过去都没有新信息出现，克里斯和莉桑迷路的观点被一种新的主流理论所取代。

sentences.en: That the pair had met with foul play.
sentences.zh: 那就是两人遭遇了不测。

sentences.en: The possibility of foul play had been considered from the outset of the investigation, but it was only when no evidence emerged to suggest otherwise
sentences.zh: 遭遇不测的可能性从调查一开始就被考虑过，但直到没有任何证据表明事实并非如此时

sentences.en: that it really started gaining traction.
sentences.zh: 这一理论才真正开始受到关注。

sentences.en: The foul play theory was mostly born from the belief that Chris and Lisanne would have never willingly ventured into the formidable trails on the other side of the pianista summit.
sentences.zh: 遭遇不测的理论主要源于这样一种信念：克里斯和莉桑绝不会自愿冒险进入皮亚尼斯塔山顶另一侧那些险峻的小路。

sentences.en: These were intelligent women who knew they were unprepared for an extended period of time in the wilderness.
sentences.zh: 这些是聪明的女性，她们知道自己没有做好在荒野中长期逗留的准备。

sentences.en: As a lawyer hired by the Kramers family later told the Daily Beast,
sentences.zh: 正如克勒默家族随后聘请的一名律师对《每日野兽》所说的那样，

sentences.en: I hiked it myself, the whole trail.
sentences.zh: 我自己徒步走过了整条小路。

sentences.en: I saw it with my own eyes.
sentences.zh: 我亲眼看到了。

sentences.en: They would never have wanted to go on down into that hell.
sentences.zh: 她们绝不会想往下走到那个地狱里去。

sentences.en: Furthermore, if one of the women had gotten sick or injured, it made sense to think that the other one would have managed to follow the trail back to safety.
sentences.zh: 此外，如果其中一名女性生病或受伤，合乎逻辑的想法是另一名女性会设法沿着小路返回安全地带。

sentences.en: As investigative journalist Peter De Vries told Dutch current affairs program
sentences.zh: 正如调查记者彼得德弗里斯对荷兰时事节目

sentences.en: Ayn Van Daag, it was plausible to think that one of the women could have slipped and fallen into a ravine, making them difficult to find.
sentences.zh: 安范达格所说，其中一名女性可能滑倒并坠入峡谷，从而导致搜寻困难，这种说法是合理的。

sentences.en: It was less likely that this would happen to them both.
sentences.zh: 这种情况同时发生在她俩身上的可能性较小。

sentences.en: Given that neither Chris, Lisanne, or any of their belongings had resurfaced during the search, Peter said,
sentences.zh: 鉴于在搜寻期间克里斯、莉桑或她们的任何随身物品都没有重新出现，彼得说，

sentences.en: You have to consider the possibility that a third party had a hand in it.
sentences.zh: 你必须考虑到第三方介入的可能性。

sentences.en: The search for the missing women shifted gears into a criminal investigation.
sentences.zh: 对失踪女性的搜寻转变为刑事调查。

sentences.en: There were two leading theories.
sentences.zh: 当时有两种主要的理论。

sentences.en: The first was that Chris and Lisanne had encountered a perpetrator while hiking the pianista who had forced them down the other side of the mountain.
sentences.zh: 第一种是克里斯和莉桑在徒步皮亚尼斯塔时遇到了犯罪分子，对方强迫她们走向山的另一侧。

sentences.en: Tourists had been robbed on the trail before, so it didn't seem far-fetched to consider that something more sinister could have taken place.
sentences.zh: 这条小路上以前曾发生过游客被抢劫的事件，因此考虑到可能会发生更具恶意的事件并非异想天开。

sentences.en: The second theory was that Chris and Lisanne had successfully completed their hike and it was upon their return to town that they met with foul play
sentences.zh: 第二种理论是克里斯和莉桑顺利完成了徒步，而是在她们返回镇上时遭遇了不测

sentences.en: and were taken to another location.
sentences.zh: 并被带到了另一个地点。

sentences.en: Chris's father told reporters,
sentences.zh: 克里斯的父亲对记者说，

sentences.en: We are extremely worried.
sentences.zh: 我们极其担忧。

sentences.en: What worries us most is that somebody could have taken them away with an evil purpose.
sentences.zh: 最让我们担心的是有人出于邪恶的目的把她们带走了。

sentences.en: Rumours swirled that the pair could have been kidnapped for ransom, were being held captive, or had been murdered by an opportunistic predator
sentences.zh: 有传言称，两人可能为了勒索赎金而被绑架、被软禁，或者被为了满足性欲或金钱动机的攻击

sentences.en: as part of a sexually or financially motivated attack.
sentences.zh: 而遭到机会主义掠夺者的杀害。

sentences.en: The more extreme rumours speculated that they could have been sold by sex traffickers, taken by drug cartels, killed by organ harvesters, or fallen victim to a serial killer.
sentences.zh: 更极端的传言推测，她们可能被贩卖人口者出售、被贩毒集团绑架、被器官贩子杀害，或者成为了连环杀手的受害者。

sentences.en: Although there was no evidence to support any particular theory,
sentences.zh: 尽管没有证据支持任何特定的理论，

sentences.en: Chris and Lisanne's families were taking no chances.
sentences.zh: 但克里斯和莉桑的家属没有放过任何侥幸心理。

sentences.en: With the investigation turned criminal, they began handing out flyers and plastering life-sized banners with their daughters' faces on them around Boguete.
sentences.zh: 随着调查转为刑事性质，他们开始在博盖特分发传单，并在各处张贴印有女儿面容的真人大小横幅。

sentences.en: They hired a private investigator and created an organisation called
sentences.zh: 他们雇用了私家侦探，并成立了一个名为

sentences.en: The Foundation to Find Lisanne and Chris, calling for donations from the public to help fund their ongoing search efforts.
sentences.zh: 寻找莉桑和克里斯基金会的组织，向公众呼吁捐款，以资助他们持续的搜寻工作。

sentences.en: Appearing at an informal press conference,
sentences.zh: 在一次非正式的新闻发布会上，

sentences.en: Peter Froon told reporters,
sentences.zh: 彼得弗龙对记者说，

sentences.en: Dear Lisanne and Chris,
sentences.zh: 亲爱的莉桑和克里斯，

sentences.en: Please know that we will stay here in Panama until you have been found.
sentences.zh: 请知道我们将留在巴拿马，直到你们被找到为止。

sentences.en: We will wait as long as it takes, and we will not give up.
sentences.zh: 无论花多长时间我们都会等待，我们绝不放弃。

sentences.en: Really, we won't.
sentences.zh: 真的，我们不会的。

sentences.en: Have faith in us.
sentences.zh: 请对我们保持信心。

sentences.en: Chris's mother, Raleigh, refused to believe the worst had happened.
sentences.zh: 克里斯的母亲雷利拒绝相信最糟糕的事情已经发生。

sentences.en: To get her through the days, she repeated a mantra over and over in her head.
sentences.zh: 为了度过这些日子，她在脑海里一遍又一遍地重复着一句话。

sentences.en: She's alive, and she will be found.
sentences.zh: 她还活着，她会被找到的。

sentences.en: She's alive, and she will be found.
sentences.zh: 她还活着，她会被找到的。

sentences.en: The families increased the reward for information to $30,000.
sentences.zh: 家属将提供线索的悬赏金提高到了3万美元。

sentences.en: This was a significant amount in Panama, enough to ensure a comfortable life.
sentences.zh: 这在巴拿马是一笔巨款，足以确保过上舒适的生活。

sentences.en: While the previous reward was motivation for volunteers to join the search, the revised amount was intended to entice individuals
sentences.zh: 虽然之前的悬赏是志愿者加入搜寻的动力，但调整后的金额旨在诱使个人

sentences.en: to report suspicious activity among their close circles.
sentences.zh: 举报其密友圈内的可疑活动。

sentences.en: Dini Froon told reporters,
sentences.zh: 迪妮弗龙对记者说，

sentences.en: The coverage has to get bigger.
sentences.zh: 报道的范围必须扩大。

sentences.en: There must be people here who know something.
sentences.zh: 这里一定有人知道些什么。

sentences.en: The boosted reward led to an influx of tips, including an unsubstantiated report that two decomposing bodies had been found in the jungle.
sentences.zh: 提高悬赏金带来了大量线索，其中包括一条未经证实的报告，称在丛林中发现了两具腐烂的尸体。

sentences.en: Nothing brought investigators any closer to the truth, and with more leads trickling in, it became harder for them to stay on top of things.
sentences.zh: 没有任何线索让调查人员更接近真相，随着越来越多的线索断断续续涌现，他们越来越难以掌控全局。

sentences.en: The people of Bocchete were deeply affected by what was going on.
sentences.zh: 博切特的人民对所发生的事情深感触动。

sentences.en: It was a small community, and they felt great sympathy for the loved ones of the missing women.
sentences.zh: 这是一个小社区，他们对失踪女性的亲人深表同情。

sentences.en: As the sixth week passed without a solid lead emerging, residents organised a silent march in honour of Chris and Lisan.
sentences.zh: 在第六周过去而没有出现确凿线索的情况下，居民们为纪念克里斯和莉桑组织了一场静默游行。

sentences.en: The families thanked the people of Panama for their heartfelt support and announced that they'd be working closely with the newly assigned state prosecutor,
sentences.zh: 家属感谢巴拿马人民发自内心的支持，并宣布他们将与新指派的州检察官密切合作，

sentences.en: Betsayda Pitti, who specialised in criminal cases.
sentences.zh: 贝赛达皮蒂专门处理刑事案件。

sentences.en: Citizens of Amersfort also rallied behind the families, with various organisations holding fundraisers to raise money for the foundation to find Lisan and Chris.
sentences.zh: 阿默斯福特的市民也声援家属，各种组织举办了筹款活动，为寻找莉桑和克里斯的基金会筹集资金。

sentences.en: By late May,
sentences.zh: 到了5月下旬，

sentences.en: Bocchete's rainy season was in full swing.
sentences.zh: 博切特的雨季正如火如荼地进行着。

sentences.en: Specialist rescue dogs were flown in from the Netherlands, but their search was hindered by heavy rainfall.
sentences.zh: 专业搜救犬从荷兰空运过来，但它们的搜寻因大雨而受阻。

sentences.en: Despite these challenges, the Dutch teams trudged on for eight days, before concluding that there was nothing to indicate
sentences.zh: 尽管面临这些挑战，荷兰团队还是艰难地搜寻了八天，然后得出结论认为没有任何迹象表明

sentences.en: that Chris and Lisan were anywhere in the mountains of Bocchete.
sentences.zh: 克里斯和莉桑在博切特的群山中的任何地方。

sentences.en: Their parents were at a loss for what to do next.
sentences.zh: 她们的父母对下一步该做什么感到不知所措。

sentences.en: By the time the K-9 team returned to the Netherlands on June 4,
sentences.zh: 到搜救犬队于6月4日返回荷兰时，

sentences.en: Chris and Lisan had been missing for over two months and not a single clue had emerged to suggest what had happened to them.
sentences.zh: 克里斯和莉桑已经失踪两个多月了，没有出现哪怕一条线索来暗示她们遭遇了什么。

sentences.en: If they weren't in the mountains, then where were they?
sentences.zh: 如果她们不在山上，那她们在哪里？

sentences.en: Worried sick, the families decided to return to the Netherlands where they could organise more help and figure out their next steps.
sentences.zh: 急火攻心的家属决定返回荷兰，在那里他们可以组织更多援助并弄清下一步的对策。

sentences.en: They didn't have to wait for long.
sentences.zh: 他们没有等太久。

sentences.en: They'd barely been home a week when finally there was the first big break in the case.
sentences.zh: 他们回国刚满一周，案件终于迎来了第一个重大突破。

sentences.en: Irma Mirando was a member of the indigenous Norbert tribe.
sentences.zh: 尔玛米兰多是诺伯特土著部落的成员。

sentences.en: She lived in the remote village of Alto Romero, which was roughly a 12-hour trek north from the summit of the Pianista.
sentences.zh: 她住在偏远的阿尔托罗梅罗村，从皮亚尼斯塔山顶向北大约需要步行12小时。

sentences.en: On Wednesday, June 11, 2014, ten weeks after Chris and Lisan were last seen,
sentences.zh: 2014年6月11日星期三，即克里斯和莉桑最后一次露面十周后，

sentences.en: Irma was washing clothes in the Rio Culebra.
sentences.zh: 尔玛正在库莱布拉河里洗衣服。

sentences.en: Known to English speakers as the Serpent River, the freshwater river earned its name for the snake-like way it spiralled through the region.
sentences.zh: 这条淡水河被英语使用者称为蛇河，因其呈蛇形盘旋穿过该地区而得名。

sentences.en: Irma caught sight of something wedged between some driftwood and rocks of the riverbank.
sentences.zh: 尔玛瞥见河岸的浮木和岩石之间卡着什么东西。

sentences.en: She went to take a closer look.
sentences.zh: 她走近去仔细查看。

sentences.en: It was a backpack.
sentences.zh: 那是一个双肩背包。

sentences.en: Inside, among other items, was an insurance card.
sentences.zh: 在里面，除了其他物品外，还有一张保险卡。

sentences.en: Irma was all too aware that two Dutch women had recently gone missing from the area.
sentences.zh: 尔玛非常清楚最近有两名荷兰女性在该地区失踪。

sentences.en: When she saw the name on the card, she recognised it immediately.
sentences.zh: 当她看到卡片上的名字时，她立刻认了出来。

sentences.en: Lisan Froon.
sentences.zh: 莉桑弗龙。

sentences.en: Irma and her husband took the backpack to the home of a local cattle rancher, who contacted the authorities on their behalf.
sentences.zh: 尔玛和她的丈夫把背包带到了当地一个养牛场主家里，后者代表他们联系了当局。

sentences.en: The following day, a helicopter was dispatched to Alto Romero to collect the lightweight Burton brand daypack.
sentences.zh: 第二天，一架直升机被派往阿尔托罗梅罗回收这个轻便的伯顿品牌日用背包。

sentences.en: Save for some dirt, scratch marks and discolouration, it was in relatively good condition.
sentences.zh: 除了有些泥土、划痕和变色外，它保存得相对完好。

sentences.en: One of the straps was partially loose and there were some small holes and tears, but the contents remained intact.
sentences.zh: 其中一条肩带部分松脱，还有一些小洞和裂口，但里面的物品完好无损。

sentences.en: This included Lisan's Samsung Galaxy smartphone,
sentences.zh: 其中包括莉桑的三星盖乐世智能手机，

sentences.en: Chris's iPhone,
sentences.zh: 克里斯的iPhone，

sentences.en: Lisan's digital camera, two bras, two pairs of sunglasses, a water bottle and $83 in cash.
sentences.zh: 莉萨的数码相机、两条胸罩、两副太阳镜、一个水瓶以及83美元现金。

sentences.en: Lisan was an amateur photographer and she'd been using the Canon PowerShot SX270 camera to document their trip since the beginning.
sentences.zh: 莉萨是一名业余摄影师，从行程一开始，她就一直用佳能PowerShot SX270相机记录他们的旅程。

sentences.en: The camera contained a 16 gigabyte memory card, which was still accessible, despite being exposed to water.
sentences.zh: 相机里有一张16GB的存储卡，尽管泡过水，但仍然可以读取。

sentences.en: Investigators watched with anticipation as the images began to load.
sentences.zh: 调查人员满怀期待地看着照片开始加载。

sentences.en: The photos proved that Lisan and Chris did indeed hike the Pianista on Tuesday, April 1, 2014, but the pictures didn't align with the witness sightings
sentences.zh: 这些照片证实，莉萨和克里斯确实在2014年4月1日星期二徒步登上了皮亚尼斯塔山，但这些照片与之前提供的

sentences.en: that had previously been provided.
sentences.zh: 目击证言并不相符。

sentences.en: A taxi driver said he'd dropped the Dutch women off near the Pianista just before 2pm, with various witnesses then claiming to have seen the duo climbing up the mountain
sentences.zh: 一名出租车司机称，他在下午2点前不久将这两名荷兰女子在皮亚尼斯塔山附近放下，随后多名目击者称看到两人在

sentences.en: between 3 and 4.15pm.
sentences.zh: 下午3点到4点15分之间向上爬山。

sentences.en: Each of the photos contained a digital timestamp, which proved that they'd actually started the hike at 11am.
sentences.zh: 每张照片都带有数字时间戳，这证明她们实际上是在上午11点开始徒步的。

sentences.en: Straight off the bat, this debunked the timeline that investigators had been working with since the very start of the women's disappearance.
sentences.zh: 这直接推翻了调查人员自两名女子失踪之初以来一直采用的时间线。

sentences.en: From Chris and Lisan's attire, it was clear they didn't set out for anything other than a leisurely hike.
sentences.zh: 从克里斯和莉萨的着装来看，很明显她们此行只是为了轻松地徒步游玩。

sentences.en: Both women were dressed in shorts and tank tops, carrying nothing between them except Lisan's backpack.
sentences.zh: 两名女性都穿着短裤和背心，身上除了莉萨的背包外什么也没带。

sentences.en: They wore hiking boots, but had no hats, jackets, or protective gear.
sentences.zh: 她们穿着登山靴，但没有戴帽子、夹克或任何防护装备。

sentences.en: Lisan captured the scenery as they made their way up the trail, with Chris often stopping to pose ahead of her.
sentences.zh: 当她们沿小路向上走时，莉萨拍摄着沿途的风景，克里斯则经常停下来在她前方摆姿势。

sentences.en: It was a bright, sunny day and the two friends looked happy.
sentences.zh: 那天阳光明媚，两位朋友看起来很高兴。

sentences.en: Metadata showed that they reached the Mirador Summit at 1pm.
sentences.zh: 元数据显示，她们在下午1点到达了米拉多尔山顶。

sentences.en: A series of elated selfies captured Chris and Lisan grinning proudly as they gave the thumbs up symbol, showing off the epic landscape stretching behind them.
sentences.zh: 一系列兴高采烈的自拍照捕捉到了克里斯和莉萨自豪地咧嘴笑着、竖起大拇指的画面，她们身后展现着壮丽的风景。

sentences.en: Up until this point, there was nothing out of the ordinary about their actions, and their photos indicated they were alone on the trail.
sentences.zh: 直到此时，她们的行为并没有什么异常，照片显示她们在小路上是独自一人的。

sentences.en: But from there on in, that all changed.
sentences.zh: 但从那以后，一切都变了。

sentences.en: Photos showed that Chris and Lisan did indeed travel onwards down the indigenous trails on the other side of the divide, away from Borkete.
sentences.zh: 照片显示，克里斯和莉萨确实继续向前，走过了分水岭另一侧远离博尔凯特的土著小径。

sentences.en: A photo taken after they'd left the summit showed Chris crossing over a stream and heading further downhill.
sentences.zh: 一张拍摄于她们离开山顶之后的照片显示，克里斯正在过一条小溪并继续向山下走去。

sentences.en: Specialists familiar with the area identified this spot as less than an hour's hike from the top of the summit in the wrong direction.
sentences.zh: 熟悉该地区的专家确认，这个地点距离山顶不到一小时的步行路程，方向完全走反了。

sentences.en: There was nothing in the pictures to indicate why they'd continued onwards, but some interpreted the expression on Chris's face as no longer being happy and carefree.
sentences.zh: 照片中没有任何迹象表明她们为什么要继续前进，但有些人解读克里斯脸上的表情时，认为她已经不再快乐和无忧无虑了。

sentences.en: From there, things only got stranger.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，事情变得更加奇怪了。

sentences.en: For eight days, there were no more photos.
sentences.zh: 在长达八天的时间里，再也没有出现新的照片。

sentences.en: Then, on Tuesday April 8 at 1.29am, the camera sprung back into action.
sentences.zh: 然后，在4月8日星期二凌晨1点29分，相机再次启动了。

sentences.en: Over a period of almost three hours,
sentences.zh: 在将近三个小时的时间里，

sentences.en: 90 similar images of near-total darkness were captured.
sentences.zh: 拍摄了90张几乎全黑的相似照片。

sentences.en: Some were taken just seconds apart, others several minutes.
sentences.zh: 有些照片只相隔几秒钟，有些则相隔几分钟。

sentences.en: Only one image captured anything other than blackness.
sentences.zh: 只有一张照片拍到了除了黑暗以外的东西。

sentences.en: It was the back of someone's head, presumably Chris Kramer's, her long strawberry blonde hair filling the entire shot.
sentences.zh: 那是某人的后脑勺，据推测是克里斯·克拉默斯，她长长的草莓金发占满了整个画面。

sentences.en: In a bid to make sense of the night-time photos, investigators resized the images and manipulated their brightness levels.
sentences.zh: 为了弄懂这些夜间照片，调查人员调整了照片的大小并处理了亮度。

sentences.en: Although they were still dark, this allowed them to make out some of the items in the frame.
sentences.zh: 尽管它们依然很暗，但这让他们能够辨认出画面中的一些物品。

sentences.en: Numerous bright specks indicated it had been raining at the time the photos were taken, which aligned with the recorded weather patterns from the time in question.
sentences.zh: 无数明亮的斑点表明拍照时正在下雨，这与当时记录的天气模式相符。

sentences.en: Several of the images captured what appeared to be trees, foliage, moss-covered rocks and large boulders.
sentences.zh: 几张照片捕捉到了貌似树木、树叶、长满苔藓的岩石和大圆石的景象。

sentences.en: In one photo, a twig with red plastic attached to it had been placed on the rock face, seemingly intentionally, like some kind of marker.
sentences.zh: 在其中一张照片中，一根系着红色塑料的树枝被放在岩壁上，似乎是故意放的，就像某种标记一样。

sentences.en: Another photo captured several pieces of what looked like intentionally torn up rubbish sitting on the rock face.
sentences.zh: 另一张照片拍到了几片看起来像是被人故意撕碎的垃圾，散落在岩壁上。

sentences.en: From the positioning of the angle, it appeared that the photos had been taken by someone who was either sitting or lying down and facing the camera slightly upwards.
